sentences.text:
Veersain vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 December, 2023
Author: Rajiv Gupta

Bench: Rajiv Gupta
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 45135 of 2023
Applicant :- Veersain

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Vijay Kumar Yadav,Bhaiya Lal Yadav,Kapil Dev Yadav

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
1. Vakalatnama filed by Shri Prashant Ji Pandey on behalf of O.P .

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
3.

This application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to quash the entire proceeding arising out of complaint No. 729 of 2020, Smt. Reena Vs. Veersain, u/s 376, 323,
342, 506 I.P.C., P.S. Titaro, District Saharanpur, pending in the court of A.D.J.-13, Saharanpur.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant has made a statement at the bar, on instructions, that he does not want to press other prayers made in the application and states that the applicant is ready to surrender before the court below and seek his bail and that his release be considered in view of law Veersain vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/182164750/
1 laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51.
5.

entities.text: Veersain vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Per contra, learned A.G.A. as well learned counsel for O.P. No.2 has submitted that he has no objection to the prayer made by learned counsel for applicant for not pressing the other prayers made in the application.

6. In view of the above, in case the applicant appears before the court below within three weeks from today and seeks bail, his release be considered in view of law laid down by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51.
7.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in (2022) 10 SCC 51
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: With the aforesaid observations, this application filed u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed of.
